text: AMSCO writes the message into a grid in cells of one and two letters by turns, then reads the columns in a key word's order. Every dictionary word of 3 to 15 letters is the key here, starting with either cell size.
After the move a repeating secret word on the table must give the copper's letters where the known letters landed; two known letters in one slot of the word must agree.

Period 23 after the move: 21 settings against 1-15, or 15 distinct check sets against 1-9, from obscure key words. Over 52 cells about 4.7 such excesses are expected by chance, so this one is within chance.
